items.statement: Parents in the most deprived neighbourhoods are least aware that fluoridation has stopped and least likely to have changed how they protect their children's teeth.
items.rationale: Knowledge is lowest in deprived areas (claim c3) and harm falls there (claim c2).
items.risks: A qualitative study describes, it does not estimate prevalence.

items.statement: Trust in the council, more than knowledge about teeth, explains how residents talk about the decision.
items.risks: Interviewers from public health may be distrusted themselves.

items.statement: Dental teams would advise families more consistently with a shared script from public health.
items.risks: A script may be seen as campaigning.

summary: Three working propositions to sensitise the interview guide; h1 selected.
